name: personal_context_halve_leader
note: The ctest trains the context with frequency Disabled and only the final Session uses Halve; one scenario has one set of options, so the training commits here also run under Halve (寅 is picked at index 2 and halving applies), which changes the weights the ctest checks at :600-603.

databases.msime-pinyin.db: BEGIN;CREATE TABLE tbl_1_n(key TEXT, jp TEXT, value TEXT, weight INTEGER);INSERT INTO tbl_1_n VALUES('ni','n','甲',100),('ni','n','乙',90),('ni','n','丙',80);CREATE TABLE tbl_1_h(key TEXT, jp TEXT, value TEXT, weight INTEGER);INSERT INTO tbl_1_h VALUES('hao','h','子',100),('hao','h','丑',90),('hao','h','寅',80);CREATE TABLE tbl_2_n(key TEXT, jp TEXT, value TEXT, weight INTEGER);INSERT INTO tbl_2_n VALUES('ni''hao','nh','你好',1000);COMMIT;

steps.arg: SELECT key,value,weight FROM tbl_1_h ORDER BY 1,2
